source_caption_text:
Never forget when 16 year old NLE Choppa performed his breakout song “Shotta Flow” at his high school 😭🔥

NLE Choppa came into the game with something to prove on “Shotta Flow” 🔥 At just 16 years old, he brought the energy, animated delivery, and confidence that made the track impossible to ignore.

Released in 2019, the song introduced the Memphis rapper to a much bigger audience. The video was a huge part of the appeal, with Choppa and his crew bringing the same energy on camera that he had on the mic. The Blueface remix gave fans another memorable version, and “Shotta Flow” grew into a series that became a signature part of his catalog.

Years later, that original still captures the excitement of watching a new artist have their breakout moment 💯

Where does “Shotta Flow” rank among the best breakout songs of that era? 👀
